# botwatch.xyz

> botwatch.xyz is an independent cybersecurity + AI-readiness research platform.
> We run honeypots and watch how automated agents, crawlers, and threat actors
> behave across the web, then turn that into two things: threat intelligence, and
> an independent read on how ready any company's website is for the agentic web
> (AI legibility, WebMCP agent-actionability, and security posture).

## What you can do here

- [Company AI-readiness directory](https://botwatch.xyz/directory): Browse every company we've profiled, ranked by how ready their site is for AI agents. Category pages at /directory/{category}.
- [Company profiles](https://botwatch.xyz/company/{hostname}): An independent AI-readiness, WebMCP, and security-posture profile for any domain, e.g. /company/example.com.
- [Free AI-readiness check](https://botwatch.xyz/readiness-check): Enter a URL to get an instant, free read on its AI readiness; a full report is available for $5 AUD.
- [Live threat intelligence](https://botwatch.xyz/intel): Real-time aggregate stats on the bots, attacks, and crawlers hitting our sensors.
- [Free threat blocklist](https://botwatch.xyz/data): A downloadable list of high-confidence malicious IPs (txt/csv/json), plus /blocklist.txt.
- [API](https://botwatch.xyz/docs): A public API for IP risk scores, domain intelligence, and the threat feed.

## About the platform

- [Methodology](https://botwatch.xyz/methodology): How we detect malicious bots — honeypots, a behavioural ML model, payload & CVE analysis, novel-payload detection, and passive enrichment.
- [Contact & responsible disclosure](https://botwatch.xyz/contact): Reach us at info@botwatch.xyz; security reports welcome.

## Key facts

- AI-readiness has two pillars: legibility (can agents read a site — llms.txt, structured data, AI-crawler policy) and actionability (can agents act on it — WebMCP).
- WebMCP is an emerging Chrome standard that lets a site expose typed tools an AI agent can call directly, instead of scraping the UI.
- botwatch assesses sites passively and independently; it is not affiliated with the sites it profiles.
- We welcome AI crawlers and answer engines — see /robots.txt and /ai.txt.
